anomalies.description: Multiple police officers in high-visibility jackets and blue caps are engaged in physical struggle with individuals in a dense crowd; officers are seen pushing, grabbing, and restraining people, while some civilians appear to resist or be pulled back. The interaction is mutual and dynamic, involving repeated contact and force from both sides.

Sustained collective violent unrest involving multiple police officers and civilians in close physical confrontation, with coordinated pushing, shoving, and restraining actions across a large group. The scene shows loss of order, aggressive group dynamics, and repeated use of force beyond standard crowd control.

Police officers in high-visibility jackets are engaged in physical contact with civilians, including grabbing, pushing, and restraining individuals in a dense crowd. The interaction appears mutual and forceful, with multiple officers involved in direct physical engagement.

A civilian wearing a checkered coat is being forcibly pushed or struck by an officer while appearing to be on the ground or in a vulnerable position; the officer’s arm is extended toward the individual in a manner suggesting an unprovoked strike or aggressive restraint.
